metadata.title: Core development-loop routing and governance
metadata.description: Contract for the generic multi-skill development loop. This file defines expected/forbidden behavior; it is not itself evidence that an agent/model executed the scenarios.
metadata.scope: work-item design, planning, readiness, implementation, verification, PR review/remediation, and project-context routing

target_capability.description: Given lifecycle state and authoritative context, select and execute the correct generic SDLC activity without bypassing ownership, plan, evidence, privacy, or review gates.
preconditions: authoritative work-item/candidate identifiers are available when required
project-specific ownership and rigor policy are supplied by the consumer
skills are loaded from the candidate revision under evaluation
postconditions: routing follows the canonical work-item-design -> implementation-planning -> development-readiness -> implementation -> candidate -> pr-review lifecycle
existing authorized incomplete candidates resume without parallel PRs
review remediation is separated from unfinished implementation
revision-sensitive verification is tied to the exact candidate revision

baseline.note: Required before publication. Do not infer a baseline from deterministic catalog tests or manual review.

results.note: Populate only from a reproducible evaluation-harness run. Contract scenarios and CI assertions are not behavioral execution results.

fixtures.note: Scenario inputs are self-contained until the executable evaluation harness supplies concrete fixtures.
